assets.theme: Matched Circular Fabric Swatches with Soft and Stiff Drape
assets.prompt: Create a 4K horizontal 16:9 reference plate for a textile sourcing deck or a garment design workbook. Set two circular swatches side by side on identical small circular supports, viewed from directly above. Center both supports at the same height in the composition. Use closely matched warm ivory textiles so the silhouette carries the comparison. Give the softer swatch deeper hanging folds and a compact scalloped outline, and the firmer swatch broader folds with a more extended perimeter. Show subdued warp grain and believable thickness along the exposed cut edges. Use neutral diffuse lighting and slight directional shading to distinguish raised folds from fabric hanging below the support. A plain light background, generous top margin, and wide central gutter should allow buyer supplied captions and individual crops. Render as an explanatory textile studio illustration with precise contours and no measured values, apparatus branding, letterforms, or decorative props.
assets.negative_prompt: flying silk, mannequins, labels, numerical coefficient, calibration markings, brand, billowing wind

assets.theme: Opened Woven Seam with Raw and Zigzag Finished Allowances
assets.palette: cream, muted clay, pale brown, slate
assets.prompt: Illustrate the reverse side of a pressed open seam for a sewing workbook or a machine stitch tutorial. Use one 16:9 horizontal 4K canvas and a close overhead view of plain matte woven cotton resting flat. The two matching seam allowances should run lengthwise side by side, connected by a fine straight seam. Show one raw edge with a few short loose warp and weft ends, and finish the other edge with an orderly zigzag in slightly darker thread so the thread path can be followed. Keep the fabric panel within the left two thirds against a soft cream background and leave the last third clear for callout text. Add quiet clearance above both edges and keep the seam legible in an inset crop. Work with precise pencil fiber detail and broad warm workshop light, revealing the thickness of each layer without deep shadows. Omit labels, hands, sewing tools, logos and numerical measurements.
assets.negative_prompt: denim flat fell, stitch numbers, red arrows, needle, sewing machine, labels, logo

assets.theme: Perforated Felt Panel with a Readable Cut Edge
assets.prompt: Render a 4K horizontal 16:9 material study for an interior specification sheet or an architectural sample board. Place one square graphite polyester felt panel at a shallow three quarter angle in the left half, with its near cut edge clearly visible. Use a simple evenly spaced array of circular through holes and reveal a few soft compressed fibers at each rim. The apertures should share one axis and their visible walls should agree with the slab thickness. Use diffuse overhead light with a restrained grazing accent on cut fibers and a calm putty background. Preserve material texture at full size without turning the face into visual noise. Leave the right side clear for a finish legend or product information, and keep the complete silhouette inside the crop margins so it can be masked as an insert. Exclude logos, measurements, sound performance indicators, room context, screws, and decorative shadows.
assets.negative_prompt: foam pyramids, hanging lamps, branded patterns, warped apertures, misleading ratings, labels, logos

assets.theme: Branching Hoarfrost along One Edge of Dark Optical Glass
assets.palette: near black, ice gray, cool white
assets.prompt: Make a 4K vertical 9:16 macro illustration for a winter editorial cover or a cold weather campaign story card. Show a flat slab of near black optical glass with slender hoarfrost dendrites clustering along part of its left boundary. Concentrate white ice in the middle third of that edge and let the growth thin gradually toward center. Use tiny secondary branches with plausible tapered ends, small interruptions in growth, and a few dim crystals underneath the brightest ones. Light the glass obliquely with a narrow neutral source that catches crystal facets while keeping the dark field near uniform. Preserve clear zones at the top and bottom for interface elements and keep the right half clear for type. Maintain clean luminance separation so the artwork can also be blended in Screen mode at the designer's discretion. Deliver an opaque dark field with no window frame, room reflections, lettering, logos, or added snow icons.
assets.negative_prompt: window frames, bokeh, room, caulk, white frame, snowflakes, lens flare, checkerboard, brand

assets.theme: Intersecting Rain Rings with a Clear Lower Copy Field
assets.palette: deep slate, cold gray, pearl, charcoal
assets.prompt: Paint an opaque 4K 16:9 macro water surface for a waterproof gear banner or a physics lesson opener. Look down at a shallow angle so two small groups of expanding rings read as coherent ellipses. Place their distinct centers in the upper left and the upper middle with just enough overlap for the intersection to be understood. Do not show a falling drop or a tall splash. Keep a deep slate lower field nearly smooth, with a broad tonal plateau that can carry a course title or product callout. Use a diffused pearl reflection skimming raised crests, restrained dark troughs, and gradual decay in contrast moving away from each center. Build the image as measured naturalistic illustration with delicate edge detail and no visible horizon. Preserve a margin around the active upper area for wide banner crops. Keep all lettering, logos, landmarks, and ornamental light flares out of the artwork.
assets.negative_prompt: ocean horizon, splash crown, reflection of buildings, fantasy rings, rain streaks, text, logo

assets.theme: Pollen Exine Relief with an Open Annotation Margin
assets.prompt: Compose a 4K horizontal 16:9 editorial science illustration for a museum microscopy activity or a plant biology lesson. Feature one generalized pollen grain in the left half against a matte charcoal field. Show a gently elongated body with one clear longitudinal furrow facing the viewer and fine raised reticulation across the surrounding exine. Let the mesh tighten and become foreshortened toward the far contour, and keep the aperture wall smoother than the outer surface. Use monochrome scientific stipple and shallow oblique illumination inspired by microscopy contrast, with distinct midtones and crisp focal edges. Keep the right half quiet for educator supplied labels, preserve perimeter margins, and balance fine detail so the whole silhouette also survives a small crop. Make it a schematic illustration rather than an instrument record and leave out measurements, scale bars, micrograph frames, identity claims, names, branding, and decorative particles.
assets.negative_prompt: species labels, virus appearance, fake scale bars, false colors, fluorescent aura, random spikes, logo
